lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Namaste Aarav! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket ball jaisi 3D shapes ke faces, edges aur corners dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya achha lagta hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Haan didi, ready hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, socho cricket kit ka cuboid box: tum batao, uske upar wale flat surfaces ko kya kahoge? Golu ko bhi sikhana hai.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, box ki flat surfaces ko faces kehte hain; screen par “face” label dekho. Ab edges ko apne words mein batao.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, matchbox ek cuboid hai. Ab next step: cuboid ke flat surfaces ko count karke batao—kitne faces hain?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, matchbox ek cuboid hai. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, har solid shape ko dhyaan se dekho. Pehle ek-ek surface par ungli rakhkar count karne ki practice karo. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Didi mujhe cricket bahut pasand hai, main roz khelta hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, tumne bataya ki tumhe cricket bahut pasand hai aur tum roz khelte ho—regular practice ka routine hai. Ab shape par dhyaan dete hain. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Haan, tumne dhyaan se gina—ab apni baat poori karo.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, ek point ko dekho jahan teen edges mil rahi hain. Us jagah ko shape par finger se mark karo. Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Bilkul, corner sahi—teen edges ek hi point par milti hain. Tumne kaise pehchana?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, corner kehna sahi jagah dikhata hai; ab count karke batao. School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Ek edges.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Tumne ek edge gin li; ab usi corner par milne wali baaki sticks bhi dekho, ek-ek karke. School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Namaste Aarav, aaj right angles aur circles ko cricket ke saath dekhenge—tum cricket mein kya pasand karte ho?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Haan didi, main ready hoon.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Cricket pitch ka corner socho. Bat aur ground ka kona seedha lagega, ya gol? Tumhari prediction kya hai?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Right angle ko check karne ke liye folded paper ka square corner kisi corner par rakho. Board par kaunsa corner test karoge?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aapko yaad hai pichhli baar humne kya kiya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Haan Aarav, humne folded paper se square corner banaya tha. Ab ise window ke corner par rakhkar check karo—kya dono corners milte hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Pehle paper ko half, phir half fold karke square corner banaya; window corner mein rakha. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aap meri saari baatein hamesha yaad rakhogi na?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, main ek AI teacher hoon; mujhe har baat hamesha yaad nahi rehti. Ab hum maths par lautte hain. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Paper ko corner par rakho. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Yaad hai maine aapko apne kutte ke baare mein kya bataya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Kabaddi court par do painted lines jahaan milti hain, wahaan folded paper ka square corner bilkul fit hota hai. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Tumne dhyaan se ginne ka step bataya. Ab isi tarah lines ke milne wale corner ko dekho. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
